feeds.title: Food Tank » Food Waste
feeds.description: Read posts about saving food and utilizing waste food. We're building a global community for safe, healthy, nourished eaters. We aim to educate, inspire, advocate, and create change. We spotlight and support environmentally, socially, and economically sustainable ways of alleviating hunger, obesity, and poverty and create networks of people, organizations, and content to push for food system change.

feeds.title: Food Waste Stories
feeds.description: I'm Emma, and I have been writing about food waste since 2019. For me, 'designing out' can mean wholesale system change and what we can do as individuals in our daily lives, as well as literal design solutions (which I also love). I write this blog in my spare time to uncover some of those things. I consider it more of a magazine, with articles and features.

feeds.title: Stop Food Waste
feeds.description: Stop Food Waste runs awareness-raising initiatives to share easy tips and resources on how we can make the most of our food, keep it fresher for longer and avoid food waste. Our mission is to help householders reduce the amount of food they waste and save themselves money. The campaign is managed by the Environmental Protection Agency.

feeds.title: Food Recovery Network Blog
feeds.description: Food Recovery Network is the largest student-led movement preventing food waste and ending hunger. Read our blog to know more about work.

feeds.title: Leanpath Blog
feeds.description: We believe front-line food service workers are the real change agents in the global fight against food waste. We empower them with technology and coaching to have a meaningful impact on the environment, at the same time improve their kitchen's efficiency. Leanpath-empowered culinary teams have prevented over 90 million pounds of food from being wasted.

feeds.title: Bruised Food Club Blog
feeds.description: We fight food waste and hunger in Uppsala, Sweden. Together, we want to change the food supply chain. Our food heroes organize our markets every Friday. Part of the team is responsible for picking up food while others host the market.

feeds.title: Wasted Food Research Network Blog
feeds.description: RECIPES is a research network bringing together over 40 researchers and 15 institutions connected with organizations working across the food system to advance the science needed to make our wasteful food system sustainable, equitable, and resilient.

feeds.title: Winnow Solutions Limited Blog
feeds.description: Reduce, Reuse, Rethink is the Winnow Blog. Here you'll find the latest insights and forward-thinking opinions from across the sector as we work together to reduce food waste. We are on a mission to connect the commercial kitchen, create a movement of chefs and inspire others to see that food is too valuable to waste.

feeds.title: Steamy Kitchen
feeds.description: I'm Jaden and through Steamy Kitchen my mission is to stop food waste at home! I help home cooks give new life to their leftovers, use up every last bit of veggies in the drawer with Buddha Bowl recipes for delicious, nutritious one-bowl meals, and Reverse Meal Plan a meal plan that starts backward.

feeds.title: Zero Waste Chef
feeds.description: Blog by Anne-Marie Bonneau. Zero-waste living step by step, with loads of recipes to replace your favorite packaged foods, tips on zero-waste and plastic-free living and the occasional rant.

feeds.title: Second Harvest Blog » Food Waste
feeds.description: Browse through our blogs to know more about food wastage. Our mission is to grow an efficient food recovery network to fuel people and reduce the environmental impact of avoidable food waste. We improve food access to ensure everyone, regardless of their economic situation, can have good food.

feeds.title: Foodie Save Blog
feeds.description: We are Foodie Save and it's our mission to fight the war against food waste. We are saving the environment and at the same time, are rescuing good food.

feeds.title: Full Harvest Blog
feeds.description: Full Harvest shares industry news, company announcements, and thought leadership around sustainable agriculture. Our mission is to empower sustainability at the root level with the business marketplace for surplus & imperfect produce. We help farms capture imperfect & surplus produce to sell on our marketplace.

feeds.title: Food Waste Solutions Blog
feeds.description: We work with our community to develop ways to reduce food waste in Western North Carolina. Creating solutions to the food waste problem is a win for the environment, our economy, and our community. Reducing food waste is better for our environment, but it also helps businesses and individuals save money.

feeds.title: Apeel Blog
feeds.description: Apeel is inspired by nature's own technology. From oranges to raspberries, every plant on Earth has a peel or skin that protects it. It's these edible materials found in the skins, peels, seeds, and pulp of all the fruits and vegetables we eat that enable Apeel to keep produce fresh for longer periods of time.

feeds.title: Going Zero Waste » Food
feeds.description: Helping you live a more eco-friendly and sustainable life. Zero waste, plant-based recipes that focus on using up roots and stems to avoid food waste as well as from-scratch favorites like pop-tarts. We aim to send nothing to a landfill. We reduce what we need, reuse as much as we can, send little to be recycled, and compost what we cannot.

feeds.title: FoodHero
feeds.description: FoodHero is an app that connects food merchants to consumers to quickly sell surplus fresh food that would otherwise end up in the trash. We bring those two groups together on an easy-to-use, auction-style platform to help reduce global food waste, save money for consumers and businesses, and save the planet.

feeds.title: Beyond Food Waste Blog
feeds.description: Beyond Food Waste is a platform sharing best practices for tackling food waste. Researched and written by waste specialists, we cover a range of topics including food waste legislation, policies, collection and recycling programs, communications campaigns, community initiatives, and more.

feeds.title: Jonathan Bloom
feeds.description: Jonathan Bloom blog takes a look at how America squanders nearly half of its food. He also offers tips to stop the wastage of food.
